name: dnd
title_zh: 把 D&D 5e 跑团全程装进一个持久化技能
tagline_zh: 战役、角色、战斗、NPC、骰子全在会话间留存。不用每次重开设定，开口说人话就能继续冒险。
tagline_en: Campaigns, characters, combat, NPCs, dice—all persisted between sessions. Just talk naturally and keep the.
desc_en: v2.4.0 · Dungeon Master assistant for running persistent D&D 5e campaigns. Handles campaign creation/loading, character management, combat tracking, NPC generation, dice rolling, and session state — all persisted across sessions. Invoke with /dm:dnd followed by a subcommand, or just speak naturally once a campaign is loaded.
why_zh: 状态持久化是核心差异：不是临时算骰子，而是整个战役世界在你关闭后继续活着。
why_en: The real edge is persistence: the campaign world stays alive after you close the chat, not just dice rolls.
limit_zh: 只认 D&D 5e 规则，其他 TRPG 系统不适用。需要你主动用 /dm:dnd 子命令初始化。
limit_en: D&D 5e rules only; other TRPG systems unsupported. Requires explicit /dm:dnd subcommand to initialize—pure chat can't start a campaign from scratch.
